content: Pol-me aposel kogono aanuna kogono madaa agaa mana lakesa
Gore niri moge riaae aa yaalo esepene aa pi. Neme Aa Mudu adesu-pulu nimimi Yesu rataliminalo pe. Goa pua nipu madaa kone rulaliminalo pe.
Gore onaa medalomamere niri moge riaae aa-daa dia kone sua agaa adaapu teme. Goa peme pare nimimi ni mogea aana kogono ademe. Ni ora aposel kogono aa pi-pulu nimi Aa Mudu raapu piruaeme.
Gore onaa medalomame ni rabuaniaatalo agaa teme rabu neme gupa laketo:
Gore neme aposel kogono pe rabu onaanumi nape eta mada yoto gialimi pae?
Go page neme Krais-na kogono painalo onanu-rupa mua pora-nini pamualima ya? Gore moge riaae aa medaloma-para Aa Mudu-na amenu-para Pita page nimumi pisimi-rupa mada napalima pae?
Gore Barnabas saa agu raapomere epe agaa mogetepa rabu eta kogono-rupa palipa yapae?
Dia-ga gore aanu soldia kogono pua nimuna eta mada nakabalimi. Go page aanumi nimuna eta wai poaeme-ga go eta nape yae mada nalimi. Go page aanumi mena gawa surubeme rabu go gawana adu mada neme.
Neme pa oyae madaa saa pi agaa padane nalagialo-ga Moses-na rekena agaa pagalepa:
Gawa mename konape wit rabuaa taliara medalomare nipuna agaa narogaape teme. Go agaare Gote-me mena gawanu padane madaa nata.

Dia, pare apo agaana re niaa madaa page Iagisa. E, gore Moses-me go pepamere niaa madaa page tisa. Go agaana re-re gupa: Aa laapome nipuna kogono rado pua maapu-para medame su awea pare medame eta rata. Goa pua yapare kogono pisipi rabu go aa lapome eta medaloma mea nolalo kone sua pisipi.
Goa pea-ga niaame Holi Spirit-na kone nimina robaa-para wai-rupa poaema-pulu nimina raba meape oyae mema.

Gore aa medalomame nimina oyae go-rupa mealimi-daare niaame ora mada mealima. Ora mada mealima pare niaame oyae gialepa natema. Dia, pare Krais madaa Holi Spirit meme rabu nimi lopalimi lo kedaa nagisima. Niaame niaana kedaa risimade.

Niminaaeme-ga pagalepa. Aa medalomame epe lotu ada-para kogono peme pare nimumi eta go epe lotu ada-para meme. Go page aa medalomame mo aana reke madaa eta sua epe kaa pi miru iritimi pare go eta medaloma mada neme.
Goa peme pare Aa Muduna agaa mana gupa ta: Aanu medalomame epe agaa laketemere gore onaanumi raba meape yaenu mada abutimi sa.

Pare neme abade apo pora nakurua oyae meda go-rupa namisu. Abia page neme oyae meape go rupa-daa kone nasua pepa taato. Dia-ga ni aba pa omoa pi-ga pa aa medame nina kogono madaa pedo pi agaa mada narabuaniaalia.

Pare neme epe agaa mogetore gore go madaa nina pedo pape yae-daa pare Aa mudumi ni kogono painalo agaa mana lagisa. Goa pea-ga neme epe agaa namogeata pe yaalore gore ni ora kedaame omape kone sula pawa.
Gore nina pa koneme sua go kogono pula pe yaalore gore neme yoto oyae mada mulape. Pare nina koneme page ginalo palua? Dia, Gote-me ni go kogono gisa-pulu ora pa palua.

Goa pea-ga neme ake piane yae mealua ya? Gore neme Epe Agaa mogeto rabu onaanumi ni oyae gialepa na-aato. Mada toa pare Epe Agaa disaipel kogono pere neme raaname omoa go kone ora nina epe yoto yaade.
Pol-re onaa rayona kogono aa-rupa pirisa
Gore niri pa aa medana kogono madaa adini naaki napi. Dia, pare neme onaa Krais madaa kone rulainalo onaa rayona kogono adini naaki-rupa paayo.

Goa pea-ga mo Juda aanu raapu kogono pe rabu ni ora Juda aa-rupa piruaayo. Goa pua neme Juda aanu Krais madaa kone rulaminalo pe. Go rabu neme Moses-na rekena agaana rolo-para napi pare go onaa rayomere rekena agaa waru kurua peme. Nimi rekena agaana rolo-para pimi-daa neme mo onaanu kone rulaliminalo rekena agaa kuritu.

Go page ruru rado onaanu raapu pi rabu neme nimu-rupa pirua Juda aanuna rekena agaana rolo-para napisu. Neme goa pe rabu go onaanu kone rulaliminalo pe. Go rabu neme Gote-na rekena agaa nagimi. Dia, neme Krais-na rekena agaana rolo-para pirua mogeaayo.

Gore onaa medalomame kone rulae yae robaa-para waru namea imi. Goa pea-ga nimu raapu pirua kone padane sua go onaanu raba mulalo pe. Goa pua neme onaa rayona kone mua neme nimu kagaa piraama laama penaalo kogono rado pua kone rado sua pe.
Go kogono rayo neme pere gore Epe Agaa minasaatalo pe. Go rabu go onaanumi page Epe Agaana puri mada mealimina.
Niaame aipapulu aloma puare epe yoto pua meama
Go agaa aba pageme kone salo: Aa rayome aloma pua agiralina peme pare aa padane-mame epe yoto pu mealia. Goa pea-ga nimimi page puri paloa aloma pua kogono waru pua Gote-na epe yoto pua mealimina.

Gore mo aa medare aloma polalore aba ripiare nipuna yogane puri mapalaatalo pea. Goa pea rabu nipumi pa ramuape yoto mulalo pea. Goa pea pare niaame Gote-na kogono pemare oro yaalo kagaa pirape epe yoto mulalo pema.
Goa pea-ga ni agirali talo pe rabu aipapulu redepo ne pora madaa polalore inimini nape. Ni yada pape aa-rupa pi. Goa pua ki doleme tulalore neme ki wage wage nape.

Neme naa yogane puri paboa kone surube-pulu neme nina yogane ki mogome tuaayo. Gore neme onaa medaloma go agirali lape pora kurinalo agaa laketo. Goa pea-ga pa onaa medame ne puri napabe temere naa yogane kone laapo puri mapalaayo.
